create.name: Victoria Ucele
create.bio:
Victoria Ucele, known to her students as Vicky, is a Yin Yoga teacher based in South Wales who runs Ucele Yoga. She is registered with Yoga Alliance and trained for 200 hours in Yin Yoga and anatomy, then took a further 60-hour course in breathwork and pranayama. Her classes pair the long, quiet holds of Yin postures with gentler Yang movement and work with the breath.

Much of her teaching follows the seasons. She draws on the Chinese Five Elements and on watching the natural world, and her monthly newsletter adds Celtic lore from Wales. She cares more about what a student feels inside a pose than how it looks, and helps each person adapt the shapes to their own body. She leads weekly classes and occasional workshops in Swansea, has taught retreats abroad, and shares free audio and video classes on Insight Timer and on her YouTube channel.

courses.title: Weekly Yin Yoga classes
courses.description: An hour-long Yin Yoga class in Swansea on Thursday evenings. Postures are held for several minutes with attention on the breath and on what is felt in the body.

courses.title: Yin Yoga + Balls for deep release
courses.description: A one-off Swansea workshop that combines Yin postures with simple self-massage using tennis balls to soften tight areas. Booked through her site.

free_resources.title: Victoria Ucele on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Her free Yin Yoga audio classes on Insight Timer, mostly 30 to 50 minutes long, each built around a theme such as balance, gratitude, the spine or quiet attention.
